# Tooltip

Short inverse label for icon-only controls, shown on hover/focus after 300ms.

`Icyre.Tooltip` · Overlays

## Use

```jsx
<Icyre.Tooltip content="…">…</Icyre.Tooltip>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Icyre.Tooltip" content="…">…</x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` * | `string` |  |
| `placement` | `'top' \| 'bottom'` |  |
| `open` | `boolean` |  |
| `shortcut` | `string` |  |
| `children` * | `any` |  |
